questions: Should the function treat uppercase and lowercase letters as distinct (case-sensitive) when forming pairs, or should it convert to a single case before processing?
If the sanitized word contains fewer than two alphabetic characters, should the function return an empty dictionary, or should it consider overlapping pairs differently?
Are overlapping pairs (like 'aba' producing 'ab' and 'ba') intended, or should pairs be non-overlapping (e.g., sliding window of size 2)?
Should the function consider only consecutive alphabetic characters after sanitization, or should it pair characters across non-alphabetic characters that were removed?
Is the order of pairs in the output dictionary important, or can it be any order as long as counts are correct?
Should the function handle Unicode alphabetic characters (e.g., accented letters) or only ASCII A-Za-z?
If the input word contains only non-alphabetic characters, should the function return an empty dictionary or raise an error?
Should the function count pairs that span across the boundary of the sanitized word (e.g., circular pairs) or only within the linear sequence?
